 Nitto ATP Finals 
 Watch Zverev, Alcaraz & Co. practise at the Nitto ATP Finals
 15 November 2026 
 By ATP Staff 
 © ATP Tour 
 Share:
 Zverev, Alcaraz will hit on Sunday in Turin 
 Watch live streaming below of your favourite players training on the practice courts at the Nitto ATP Finals in Turin, including Alexander Zverev, Carlos Alcaraz, Ben Shelton and more!
 Round-robin action begins at the year-end event on Sunday, with the final on 22 November. Alcaraz will hit from 1-2 pm CET on Sunday, with Flavio Cobolli taking to court from 5-6:30 pm.
 Be part of the action this fortnight in Turin and sign up here to ATP Unlocked for exclusive coverage in the Nitto ATP Finals Hub.
 Sebastopoli
